capabilityHelp.source_registration: Register data sources, and change or remove them.
capabilityHelp.table_registration: Register tables from a source, and change or remove them.
capabilityHelp.access_config: Configure row rules and other access settings.
capabilityHelp.query_development: Use the query development features. Reading data does not need this.
capabilityHelp.full_results: Get full results instead of a sample.
capabilityHelp.user_management: Manage the organization's users and their roles.
capabilityHelp.view_governance: See the catalog's governance columns: who can read a column, its masks and view SQL.
capabilityHelp.platform_settings: Read and change settings for the whole deployment.
capabilityHelp.cross_org: Act in organizations the user is not a member of.
capabilityHelp.org_settings: Read and change this organization's settings.
capabilityHelp.observability: See performance, health and traces, and read the ops domain.
capabilityHelp.environment_owned_management: Create environments, and delete the ones this role owns.
capabilityHelp.environment_switch: Work in environments other than production.
capabilityHelp.environment_data: Change an environment's data choices, such as its data mode and source bindings.
capabilityHelp.sensitive_data: Mark columns as sensitive and change how they are hidden, in every environment.
capabilityHelp.catalog_read: Read the meta domain. Without it, a role sees core metadata only for the tables it can read, write or list.
capabilityHelp.glossary_rw: Edit the glossary within this role's domains.
capabilityHelp.org_glossary_rw: Edit any glossary term in the organization.
capabilityHelp.data_product_rw: Create, edit and delete data products.
capabilityHelp.lineage_report: Send OpenLineage run events from tools such as Airflow, Spark, dbt and Flink.
capabilityHelp.dq_read: Read data quality checks and their results.
capabilityHelp.dq_rw: Manage data quality checks, expectations and promises.
capabilityHelp.ignore_relationships: Join tables that no approved relationship covers.
capabilityHelp.write: Write data, where the role has a write grant.
capabilityHelp.command_execution: Run the commands assigned to this role, in the domains it lists.
capabilityHelp.no_aggregations: Take aggregate queries away from this role.
capabilityHelp.data_residency: Set where the data of a table, a source or a materialized view lives, for the regions listed.
capabilityHelp.notHeldByParent: No parent of this role holds this capability.
capabilityHelp.domainNotHeldByParent: No parent of this role reaches this domain.
